people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.
translations.bsb: The son of Aaron who presents the blood and fat of the peace offering shall have the right thigh as a portion.
translations.kjv: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.
translations.asv: He among the sons of Aaron that offereth the blood of the peace-offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.
